targetsindicate.configuration.enabled.to: Whether to enable the damage health bar display.
targetsindicate.configuration.renderEnti: Whether to render the entity model icon (this is expensive performance‑wise).
targetsindicate.configuration.side.toolt: Which side of the screen to display: LEFT / RIGHT.
targetsindicate.configuration.maxEntries: Maximum number of targets displayed at once.
targetsindicate.configuration.entryLifet: Time in seconds after which an undamaged target starts fading out.
targetsindicate.configuration.prioritize: When enabled, the entity under the crosshair is promoted to the top slot.
targetsindicate.configuration.renderHeal: Whether to render current and maximum health after the name.
Whether to render health percentage after the name.
targetsindicate.configuration.fontShadow: Whether the info box text is rendered with a shadow.
targetsindicate.configuration.barWidth.t: Health bar width (pixels, at base scale).
Health bar height (pixels, at base scale).
Entity icon size (pixels, at base scale).
targetsindicate.configuration.rowSpacing: Extra spacing between each row in the list (pixels).
Distance from the top of the list to the top of the screen (pixels).
targetsindicate.configuration.edgeMargin: Distance from the list to the left/right screen edge (pixels).
targetsindicate.configuration.topScale.t: Display scale for the main target (top entry).
targetsindicate.configuration.subScale.t: Display scale for the remaining targets.
targetsindicate.configuration.healthHigh: Color when health percentage is high (ARGB).
targetsindicate.configuration.healthMidC: Color when health percentage is medium (ARGB).
targetsindicate.configuration.healthLowC: Color when health percentage is low (ARGB).
targetsindicate.configuration.hoverPrevi: Background color ARGB of the preview box for a crosshair target that is not yet tracked (default: semi-transparent light gray).
Text and health bar color ARGB of the preview box for a crosshair target that is not yet tracked (default: gray).
